## 881173b7bc9d

**Reproduced defect — validator accepts inputs with no rectangular frame.** With ordinary `meta=None`, `self_check([[1]])` returns `[]`; a 3×3 grid containing four disconnected colored singletons also returns `[]`. Neither input satisfies the documented invariant of at least two rectangular-border frames, so the validator cannot protect distribution checks from out-of-grammar samples. It treats any input with fewer than two nonzero connected components as an implicit degenerate even when no degenerate texture was requested, and it performs no frame test when there are two or more components.

Evidence: `checks/audit/881173b7bc9d-validator-hole.json`; reproducer: `checks/audit/reproduce_findings.py`. Generator SHA-256: `e7e43c951271a6769ab9de941e07a068defdbd5e31b01977c7673a6a73b486d9`.

The standalone lint audit also found a missing required `RULE_HASH` and an unprobeable density axis; see `checks/audit/881173b7bc9d-lint-before/checks/881173b7bc9d_before_lint.log`. I checked the selected rule’s frame definition, canonical examples, generated frame construction, axis use, and validator behavior. No files for this audit target were modified.
